description: Set a Link in Bio page's `title` (up to 100 characters), `bio` (up to 500) and/or `avatar` (a base64 JPEG or PNG up to 5 MB; a data: URL works; null removes it). Only the fields sent change; an empty title or bio removes it.

avatar.description: Base64 JPEG or PNG, or null to remove the avatar.

domain.description: Domain whose Link in Bio page this is, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

name: update_link_in_bio_profile
title: Update Link In Bio Profile
